rationale: Price continues to grind higher with each candle printing a higher high and higher low, now pressing against the intraday high at 99.7% of today's range, while remaining above the 9-EMA ($42.25) — the core structural thesis remains intact. Post-entry volume has tapered to 8–9K per candle versus the entry surge of ~34K, which is a mild yellow flag but not a reversal signal; it reflects consolidation rather than distribution given the absence of any red candles or lower lows. With invalidation at $41.98 still clearly intact and no adverse news, there is no mechanical reason to exit yet, though a failure to push above $42.38 on increasing volume in the next one to two candles would warrant reassessment.
